integrity: Exact finite-field formula from characteristic-free linear algebra and Möbius inversion; exhaustive finite tests supplement but do not replace the proof. No independent scientific audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled surjective products on fixed finite vector spaces, not algebra isomorphism classes; asymptotics hold for fixed field and output dimension only; computational tests cover small prime fields; a previously published equivalent flag enumeration cannot be excluded.
title: Joint center–annihilator flags in random cube-zero associative algebras over finite fields
